scope: Inert generic map-resolution fixture: fixed Gaussian input, fixed sun/receiver/camera/phase; only virtual camera distance changes. No combat or effects simulation. Diagnostic footage, not gameplay. No grading or amplified differences. Existing gameplay media retained.
renderer: Godot 4.7.2 ed1daf0bf; Vulkan 1.4.305 Forward+; llvmpipe LLVM 19.1.7 256 bits; Mesa 25.0.7-2+deb13u1; Xvfb :99 1280x720x24
timing: Software rendering. Fixed-fps playback is not measured hardware throughput. No performance claim.
reproduction: Write the embedded harness and inert-map scripts to the command paths (or update their absolute references); run against the base head and candidate source. The harness only invokes the renderer map, overriding source gathering with one fixed Gaussian. The final harness also supports --offset-phase and Compatibility fallback; the published Forward+ pair uses the default phase.
inert_map:
extends "res://scripts/game/smoke_shadow.gd"
func _gather() -> void:
	# Fixed renderer input. No effect emitter, world simulation or animation.
	puff(Vector3(0.0, 3.0, 0.0), 3.0, 3.0, 1.5, 0.0, 0.65, 1.11)
compatibility: Unchanged no-map fallback: identical threshold images, no shader/script errors.
